comment: This v10 pass audits the seven atomic conditions plus the explicit T9.3 source-model carrier listed in status.json. The carrier is not opaque evidence: its complete recursive field semantics remain separately validated in the current source-record lane, while this ledger routes the visible PaperInterface premise through Assumptions.lean.

hF_ge_two_h : 2 * h ≤ finiteCandidateFix.reason: Theorem 7.2 assumes the fixed-price benchmark is at least twice the high bid.

assumption_fixed_price_benchmark_large_e.reason: This is the explicit Theorem 7.2 lower-bound regime F >= 2h, written through the paper's finite candidate fixed-price benchmark on the normalized source domain.

source_routes.source_support_scope: The approved Theorem 7.2 lower-bound target retains the displayed hypothesis F >= 2h.

hmax : ∃ i : Agent, values i = h.reason: This is the finite attained-maximum meaning of the source's h parameter.

premises: hmax : ∃ i : Agent, values i = h
assumption_high_value_attained.reason: The paper defines h as the highest bid, not merely an arbitrary upper bound. The finite-profile attainment witness is the semantic condition that lets the interface use h as the source parameter.

source_routes.source_support_scope: The approved Corollary 4.2 endpoint uses the source h parameter whose highest-bid meaning is supplied by the companion definition route.
The source definition denotes h as the highest bid; this is the source-facing basis for the reviewed attained-high-value condition.

hlt : low < high.reason: Lemma 8.1 compares a bidder's allocation after increasing the bid value.

assumption_low_bid_below_high_bid.reason: The allocation-monotonicity comparison is meaningful for an actual increase in the bidder's value, so low < high is the source lemma's ordered pair condition.

source_routes.source_support_scope: The approved Lemma 8.1 target compares a strict lower bidder value with a higher bidder value.

hcdf_monotone : ∀ i j, values i ≤ values.reason: This is the journal's monotone randomized-offer condition expressed as monotonicity of the marginal offer CDF below each bidder value.
hcdf_monotone : ∀ i j, values i ≤ values.source_location: Goldberg-Hartline-Karlin-Saks-Wright 2006, Definition 8.1 and Theorem 8.2; papers/GHW01DigitalGoods/cited publication

hprice_nonneg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ price p.reason: The journal corrected target assumes nonnegative offered prices.
hprice_nonneg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ price p.source_location: Goldberg-Hartline-Karlin-Saks-Wright 2006, Definition 8.1 and Theorem 8.2; papers/GHW01DigitalGoods/cited publication

hvalue_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ values i.reason: The journal corrected target works with nonnegative bid values.
hvalue_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ values i.source_location: Goldberg-Hartline-Karlin-Saks-Wright 2006, Definition 8.1 and Theorem 8.2; papers/GHW01DigitalGoods/cited publication

premises: hcdf_monotone : ∀ i j, values i ≤ values j → ∀ t, t ≤ values i → EconCSLib.pmfProb (offerLaw i) (fun p => price p ≤ t) ≤ EconCSLib.pmfProb (offerLaw j) (fun p => price p ≤ t)
assumption_theorem8_2_journal_raw_cdf_mo.reason: The corrected Theorem 8.2 target exposes three mathematical premises: nonnegative values, nonnegative offered prices, and cross-bidder marginal-CDF monotonicity. Its signature also visibly restricts bidders and prices to finite carriers and offer laws to PMFs; those finite/discrete binders are part of the approved formal target, not conditions attributed to the journal statement. The archival preliminary statement is not treated as a consequence of either the three premises or the domain restriction.

component_semantic_review_v1.classification_basis: Canonical Lean AST only: the CDF component is the unique component with two full pmfProb applications; the price function is the unique real-valued function parameter occurring in both PMF event predicates; the value function is the other real-valued function parameter. The two remaining forall components are classified by which exact parameter atom they apply. Graph path/order and premise spelling were not used.
component_semantic_review_v1.reviewer: Codex GHW01 canonical component semantic reviewer 2026-08-03

The approved journal Theorem 8.2 target explicitly restricts bid values to the nonnegative domain.
The approved journal Theorem 8.2 target explicitly restricts offered prices to the nonnegative domain.

model : assumption_theorem9_3_primitive_.reason: The paper defines a deterministic auction as a map from a set of bids to a selected-bid/sale-price outcome, states dominant-strategy truthfulness against fixed other bids, and in Lemma 9.2 defines the focused slice g(x) = A_i(B_i^x). The carrier makes that model explicit: `focusedOutcome_represents` is a visible source-model condition governed by the recorded set-of-bids convention, while Lean derives only the later canonical-list relabeling used by the internal count proof.

assumption_theorem9_3_primitive_set_of_b.reason: Theorem 9.3 quantifies over a truthful deterministic auction. This explicit carrier preserves the source's set-of-bids focused-slice semantics and packages the source outcome, feasibility, and sale-price conventions that are otherwise implicit in the prose. Its record fields are independently checked in the source-record audit; this row records the theorem's visible source-model premise rather than treating an internal bridge or certificate as an assumption.

source_routes.source_support_scope: Theorem 9.3 and its exact convention pins supply the deterministic truthful set-of-bids model represented by the reviewed carrier.

assumption_theorem9_3_primitive_set_of_b.validator: Codex GHW01 T9.3 source-model premise provenance judge 2026-07-26

assumption_total_value_notation.reason: The weighted-pairing statements use the source's T notation for the finite sum of bids. This alias merely names that displayed equality; it contains no hidden valuation or outcome assertion.

source_routes.source_support_scope: The exact source component identifies T with the sum of submitted bids under the recorded truthful-bidding convention; the reviewed notation premise names the corresponding finite utility total.

hM : truthful M.reason: This is the antecedent of the archival valid-own-bid-support lemma only. It is not a premise of the corrected paper-facing Lemma 8.1, which follows the journal monotone-offer statement.

assumption_truthful_auction_condition.reason: Truthfulness is the explicit antecedent of the archival own-bid-support lemma and of the bid-independence lemma; its reviewed expansion is the source's fixed-other-bids dominant-strategy condition. The corrected paper-facing Lemma 8.1 instead uses the journal monotone-offer condition and does not inherit this truthfulness premise.

The source definition states the fixed-other-bids dominant-strategy truthfulness condition represented by this presentation.
